Fixed by extending the variant, which is the stronger of the two options the bead offered.

The bead: build_first_valid_path_with_config returns Err(BudgetExceeded) verbatim, dropping the accumulated tried counter and last_error, so "a user debugging a builder that tried 47 candidates and ran out of budget gets exactly the same error report as a user whose first frame ran out of budget".

Chose extending BudgetExceeded over the suggested new BudgetExceededAfterCandidates variant. One condition should not be two variants that every caller has to handle separately; the distinction belongs in the payload. tried: usize and last_error: Option<pkix_path::Error>, with the variant #[non_exhaustive] so further context is additive. The bead fallback -- "at minimum call the tradeoff out in rustdoc" -- was not needed.

The division of labour is worth recording. The candidate ITERATOR raises BudgetExceeded and cannot know either value, because it does not validate candidates; it reports tried: 0, last_error: None. The DRIVER does validate and already maintained both accumulators for NoValidPath, so it fills them in as the error passes through. The iterator tests now assert the zero/None shape explicitly, so that contract is pinned rather than implied.

Note last_error is Option<pkix_path::Error> and not Option<String>. That is only available because PKIX-rm8.29 / PKIX-wnnn.5 typed NoValidPath field first -- the accumulator this reads from now holds a typed error. Had those not landed, this would have reintroduced a stringly-typed diagnostic. source() exposes the cause when present.

Error::budget_exceeded(tried, last_error) added, since #[non_exhaustive] blocks struct-literal construction outside the crate; the iterator uses it too so there is a single spelling.

Test: the_two_budget_exhaustion_cases_report_differently. It constructs both shapes rather than provoking them -- provoking tried >= 1 requires a pool tuned so candidates are validated and rejected before the budget expires, which turns a budget constant into a brittle fixture. What it pins is what the bead cared about: the two shapes are not equal, Display distinguishes them (one names the count, the other says "before any candidate"), and the cause is reachable for the case that has one.

Gates green: fmt, clippy, rustdoc, 2358 tests, workspace feature powerset clean.
